notes.title: 🚨👮The Ranchers Police District Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Ranchers!

Hope y’all are safe and doing great!

Today, I’m excited to introduce our newest feature: The Ranchers Police District (R.P.D). 🎉🎉🎉

From the start, The Ranchers has given you tons of freedom to play the game your way. You can stick to the rules and enjoy a calm, relaxed experience, or you can mix things up—maybe even try something a little daring, like swiping NPCs' crops, cars, cows, or chickens, vandalizing public property, or even shaking up national security for a bit of mischief 😀

Ultimately, it’s your call, and you probably have your own reasons for how you play (don’t we all? 😀).


Before, if you got caught, the game would hit you with a fine to teach you a lesson—harsh and not very fun, especially in an open-world farming sim where freedom is key.

Now, things feel a bit more like real life (isn’t that what a simulation’s all about?): your actions have consequences. Each misdeed you commit will trigger a reaction from the Ranchers police, giving you the freedom to deal with it your way. 

You can pay up, surrender, or even push things further with the R.P.D—at your own risk (and potential reward) 😀


Without further ado, here’s an example of how it works:

Pay your fines and carry on with your day:


[previewyoutube=hvab9MdBrUM;full][/previewyoutube]


If you commit a repressive crime, you'll find yourself in police custody:

[previewyoutube=q4vNNpWfwWU;full][/previewyoutube]


When you're feeling brave and want to test your luck with the police!

[previewyoutube=WGHX_uhURG0;full][/previewyoutube]


Here's how the police chase mechanism works with its 5 wanted levels:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/2c3e3cc0ef6b0be2f86173a03312af27a562191a.png

Wanted Level 1: 
- Status: Code Green  
- Behavior: Police drones aim for a peaceful resolution.  
- Action: They won’t arrest or attack if you pay your fines. This level handles minor offenses—pay up, and you avoid custody.

Wanted Level 2: 
- Status:  Still Code Green  
- Behavior: No lethal force is used, but they strongly encourage you to surrender.  
- Action: If caught or if you surrender, you'll be taken into police custody, likely with a sentence.

Wanted Level 3:
- Status: Code Yellow  
- Behavior: Police drones use non-lethal, dissuasive tactics.  
- Action: Getting caught here means you'll be placed in custody with a probable sentence.

Wanted Level 4:
- Status: Code Red  
- Behavior: They’re now authorized to use light lethal weapons.  
- Action: Their goal is to end the chase quickly.

Wanted Level 5:
- Status: Code Black  
- Behavior: Heavy lethal weapons are in play to end the chase at all costs.
- Action: The police will do whatever it takes to end the chase.

At any level, you always have a choice: surrender to reduce your sentence and bail, or try your luck evading the police. 

Even if you lose the cops, their cars will continue searching for you briefly. If they catch you again, the chase restarts—but if you manage to stay hidden for a while, you'll eventually be considered evaded.

Surrender vs. Capture: What Happens Next?

If you surrender or get caught, you'll be taken into police custody and placed in a cell. There, you'll need to pay your fines and potentially serve some jail time depending on your crimes. 

Getting caught results in the maximum fines and jail time, while surrendering at any wanted level will lead to lesser fines and fewer jail days.

Plus, while you're in custody, your friends (multiplayer) can join your game, visit you, and take care of your crops and cattle— isn’t that what friends and family are for? 😀


[previewyoutube=aI0wPwbwFig;full][/previewyoutube]

What happens if you successfully evade the police?

First off, congratulations—you’ve got skills! 😀

Your fines are wiped out, and you keep all your loot ;)

Inside the Police Station

This update introduces the police station interior, where you can visit friends in custody—or serve your own time! Let's take a look:

[previewyoutube=_ZfWkQNmras;full][/previewyoutube]

Hacking Mechanics

This update introduces a hacking tool that lets you manipulate various elements in The Ranchers' world. 

Ever wanted to hijack an NPC's vehicle for a joyride? (We know you've got your reasons 😀)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/a4224e4f341f13c24ee30ef542399f4ec8a12838.png

Your hacking success depends on the security system you’re targeting. You’ll have a set number of attempts—fail too many times, and alarms (and the police) might be triggered! 

As you progress, you can upgrade your hacking tool through the skill tree (coming soon) to hack faster and tackle tougher systems.

Here’s an example of hacking an NPC vehicle with a full police chase till the evasion:

[previewyoutube=csba-KqGoT4;full][/previewyoutube]


This update also introduces two new shops:

QuickFix Garage:

QuickFix garages are scattered throughout The Ranchers’ open world. They can repair your damaged vehicle anytime—even in the middle of a police chase.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/0d9dcfc45eb1956c79b51ec456be1efa9dcfbbe2.png


Auto Hue Garage:

Normally, Auto Hue lets you change your vehicle’s paint job. In trickier situations, they can even help you by changing your vehicle’s plate numbers, removing it from the police wanted registry.

[previewyoutube=7vJtHllkkPg;full][/previewyoutube]


Stolen Vehicle Mechanic

This update introduces stolen vehicles to The Ranchers' world. If you drive a stolen vehicle, the police chase will be triggered when you're caught—unless you visit an Auto Hue Garage to change the vehicle plates.

A stolen vehicle can display:

1. Red stolen Icon: Plates haven't been changed. The police will pursue you every time they're alerted.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/e75b62ae92071ecc62993da508aa5572b6af899e.png


2.Black stolen Icon: Plates have been changed at Auto Hue garage, allowing you to keep the vehicle without triggering a chase. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/a4433d5213837b1f6a6b6fae6e1f393741fd82f4.png


Keep in mind, stolen vehicles can still be sold—but they fetch lower prices than those acquired legitimately.

Vehicle Radios
This update also introduces two radio stations you can listen to while driving:

The Ranchers Radio

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/60dedf147068802262ab803c9d6bf9f53a8e54e1.png


A favorite among ranchers, playing mostly country music and tunes that capture the essence of ranch life.


Sunvale Skyline FM:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/278ffb90efb73f6f8427be41f3601621608b1821.png

A more cosmopolitan station featuring a mix of hip-hop, pop, rock, and reggaeton.

What’s Next?

With this update, we've definitely delivered that “GTA spirit” I mentioned before in previous updates, and I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. Implementing the new police mechanic was a real challenge—finding the balance between action and keeping The Ranchers a chill, relaxing farming sim wasn't easy.

At the heart of it all, The Ranchers remains a game that offers immense freedom and a stress-free experience. It might be a bit different from what you're used to (isn't that why you try new games?), but I promise — you’re going to love it!

Now that this update is in the books, our next focus shifts back to the farming and ranching side of things. We're excited to finalize the suburb area and bring you the hunting mechanic!

If you're interested in helping shape the future of The Ranchers, feel free to join our The Ranchers Discord. And if you want to see more gameplay from this update, check out the live stream I recently hosted:

[previewyoutube=_sljrg3Vp5k;full][/previewyoutube]


Thanks so much for sticking with me, and stay tuned for more updates!  ❤️❤️❤️

Ethan

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501310/The_Ranchers/

notes.title: The Ranchers Community Update
notes.notes:
👨‍🌾 Hello Ranchers👩‍🌾

Welcome to the Beta version of The Ranchers! 

We want to celebrate this new step by showing you the very first update in this phase.

Let's take a closer look at the big changes in the new update:

🌟Revamped UI/UX
We have introduced a brand new, modern, and immersive user interface that enhances the player experience.
The entire game UI has been rebuilt from scratch, with careful attention to detail. 

There is A LOT to list here, but i will keep it simple => Experiencing it firsthand is a must!  (see the video at the end)

I have invested a significant amount of time learning about effective game UI design, ensuring that it enriches the gameplay without being intrusive. 

Today, I'm incredibly proud of the final results, as it has truly taken the game to a new level. ⏫⏫⏫

💖I hope you love it too! 💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/3c5392e9daa087bf4cdcd84ab7ecdbc5641982db.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/83140f167bd9a1d1a609fb5c0ab7a3d2c7d13487.png

⌨️ Inventory hotbar with shortcuts 
The HUD now features a convenient hotbar for your inventory, complete with keyboard shortcuts. This includes equipping/unequipping items, pressing [M] for the map, [T] for the phone, and using [Enter] to display the multiplayer chat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/623f4721210ddeb64652d21a079c5caf9dcc0203.png

🐮 Redesigned icons
All game items, tools, equipment, and vehicle icons have been redesigned to meet our new quality standards and align with the updated game UI. We revamped over 1200 icons! 🤯 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/453613ccc713a7ed9fe9991ef132fc2db2cbb97d.png

🕹️ Full compatibility with joystick 
All game UI elements are now fully compatible with the joystick, ensuring a seamless gaming experience.

🪓 Enhanced equipment interactions 
Tools, equipment, and anything that players can hold now display all possible interactions with corresponding key bindings or joystick buttons. These interaction helpers are now grouped by equipment, making it easier to understand when you have items equipped in both hands simultaneously (such as a torch and an axe...).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/486bdb0a3b397bcee95bb62f4c1bd6377abd9957.png

🛒 Bulk crafting and buying
You can now perform bulk crafting in the Craft App and at workbenches. Additionally, all shops support bulk buying, and players can sell items in bulk to shop managers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/fb5326543b7aed0cf5ab9a9862fb54c36bfd646a.png

🎥 Camera customization
You can now move the camera using the middle button of your mouse. Adjustments for camera movement speed, zoom, and auto-zoom reset have been added to the settings app, allowing for more precise customization.

⚡Zesty Metrix Smartphone App
 Introducing a new app called "Zesty Metrix" that provides real-time tracking of your ranch's energy efficiency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/9c11d6abac533925d830af3d57b9ca1437d38910.png

 👕 Extensive character customization 👗
We have introduced a comprehensive character customization system with an infinite number of combinations and possibilities. 
We've added over 400 new customization items, including hairstyles, beards, shirts, hats, and sunglasses. 
All clothing and accessories are now interchangeable between body types, and they seamlessly blend with each other without any mesh overlap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/29302ccd9afd8d3cefdfb30596476652583819d4.png

📡 New HUD indicators
We have implemented new HUD indicators to show your online/offline status and whether your ranch is open for friends to join. You can easily toggle your ranch's exposure to friends in the game settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/8330ece88a160b0e1d704fe26e498f2c28524877.png

🔨 Enhanced hammer interaction 
The hammer interaction system has been overhauled, making it easier and clearer to manipulate objects. Additionally, when the hammer is equipped, you can now interact with other elements in the game.

🚗Simplified vehicle interactions 
Interacting with vehicles has been significantly simplified, allowing for easier animal transportation, manual refueling from any position around the vehicle, and more.

🌟 Building interiors loading time reduced by 80%
The loading time when entering or exiting a building interior (such as the Barn or Coop) has been significantly reduced by 80%! 
Now you can seamlessly transition between the outdoor and indoor environments, enhancing your gameplay flow.

🖧 Multiplayer autosave and save file integrity
 In multiplayer mode, an autosave system will automatically trigger after each "important" action to prevent hacks, cheating, and item duplication. 
Save file integrity and authenticity are now verified server-side before any multiplayer session. 
The online integrity verification of save files does not impact offline mode. You can still enjoy The Ranchers at 100% when you are on the go or offline.

🎞️ how about a preview of those features? 

[previewyoutube=8qMs5ww9oKU;full][/previewyoutube]

⏭️ So, what's coming up next? 

Since the update was entirely inspired by the valuable feedback we received from our amazing community and our next priority is to personally respond to each feedback posted in Feedback channels: https://open.codecks.io/ranchers/decks/18-community-feedback 

On a broader note, I want to keep the details of the next big update as a surprise! 😄

That's all I can reveal for now, but expect more information in the upcoming weeks.

Thank you very much for taking the time to read this, and stay tuned for more exciting news! ❤️

Best,

Ethan

notes.title: The Ranchers, Ranching v2 update! 🐐
notes.notes:
Hello Ranchers 🧑‍🌾 

Long time no see! Since the last time we posted, we’ve been busy with our alpha version of The Ranchers and with all the amazing feedback that we received from everyone who’s played this version. Thank you to each and everyone of you who’s taken the time to help us make The Ranchers the best possible version of itself for the future ahead.💕

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/18447de0d863a9e8cbf52eaf5e6ed012366e09d2.png

Our latest and final update in the alpha stage entails a lot of new mechanics, Quality of Life updates and new elements to the gameplay:

🌼Addition of new animals species  
🐰 Rabbits
🐐 Goats
🐓 Addition of  2 new variations for the Rooster, new Calves for cows and bulls and chicks for chickens to represent their early growth stage 

➕Read more here: http://wiki.ranchers.game/Ranching/Mammal-Animals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/65b8f9d6672a4722e75c75a361b1d86d8701ccaf.png

🐮Additional new animal mechanics and QoL
🌱New livestock feeding system. Now each species has its unique diet.
🌱New Pregnancy mechanic for Mammals Animals.
🌱New Eggs hatching mechanic for Oviparous Animals.
🌱New Animal Sickness mechanic.
🌱All livestock can be raised outdoor without necessary having a barn or a coop. There will be consequences with time, but hey that also means you can have them early!

➕➕ Read more here: https://wiki.ranchers.game/en/Ranching


🏡New Barns, Coops, Silos, Water Towers, Troughs and Fences!
🌱 Addition of new farm fences and fence doors that can be crafted by the player.
🌱Addition of 3 new Barns types with their exclusive interiors design.
🌱Addition of 3 new Coops types with their exclusive interiors design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/9e57982a459ccb3dbff439164afae6cf53cdf0f2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/2d6efb6639bbc8de75cca3ef22b3d738b41ffa70.png

➕➕ Read more about here: http://wiki.ranchers.game/Ranching/Barn 

🌼 All the Barns and Coops can now have Feature Kits
🌱Auto-Feeding Kit, it will feed your animals automatically.
🌱Air Conditioning Kit, It will prevent your animals from becoming ill by keeping them warm in Winter and cool in Summer - You can see how your buildings/features kits are linked to each other by hovering your mouse on them with the hammer equipped.
🌟This whole building  feature kits "linkage system" will open a lot of great new game mechanics that will come in the future.
🌱All Coops and Barns doors can be opened or closed as you wish (with benefits and consequences of course). 
🌱Introduction of Silos.
🌱Introduction of Water Towers.
🌟By combining Feature Kits, Silos and Water Towers you can now automatize your whole livestock feeding needs.
🌱Introduction of animal Troughs that can be crafted and placed in the ranch to feed your livestock when they are outside of the barn/coop or if you are raising them outdoor.

➕➕Read more about Feature Kits here: http://wiki.ranchers.game/Items/Barn-Auto-Feeder-Kit
➕➕Read more about Silos and Water Towers here: http://wiki.ranchers.game/Buildings/Silo


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/c6e5f2ad0b5bb358f226d07f59871c1c63aaa171.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/be32b0438d4fa0f6937d0577a7fc0d8598924d0c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/fd3ad44cd2c0aaadb82d1bb882f60a4e8c522494.png


🐄 All livestock do use a new "systemic food seeking" algorithm to find food and drinks sources in your ranch (Water troughs, different food troughs, wild grass, vegetables, etc).
🌱Addition of new models to the existing species: 2 new variations for the Rooster, new Calf's for cows and bulls and chicks for chickens to represent their early growth stage 🐓
🌱The quality of all the animals' 3D models has been upgraded for better visual quality 
🌱Polishing round for all the livestock animations!
🌱Meat, Milk and Eggs are now animal specific (this is will make the cooking very precise!)
🌱Animals do play a specific sound to let you know if they liked your gifts or not! 🌱Animals can now be named!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/5e81f126f0cf491e1847f537b66861282de2566d.png

🌟Quality of Life updates
🌱 Wild grass do produce Hay regardless of their growth stage.
🌱 New sprinkler 3D model for "basic sprinkler".
🌱Items that have "grid coverage" mechanic, like Sprinklers, Scarecrows and Silos do now show their coverage with a visible grid in game.
🌱 All the crafted buildings give 50% back of resources when destroyed accidentally. 
🌱 All the tools, animals, vehicles, and so on, can now have multiples rarity variations that will affect the item internal statistics (price, storage capacity, speed..)
🌱 Addition of a new section in "the end of the day summary" that will have all the important notices that happened during the night (ex. new animal give birth)
🌱 In "the end of the day summary", if nothing happened (results at 0 Coins and 0 notices), the animation duration is much much faster!
🌱  New Player animations:
When eating and drinking.
 Filling the watering can.
 Tired and holding the phone or the gun/rifle.
 Aim with the gun/rifle.
🌱Balancing the Player energy and health.
🌱Long range weapons can now be used when player is in the air (jumping, falling, etc.)
🌼 A new day will only start when you hit "Start new day" button in "the end of the day summary". And that's how you can pause the game. This also works when playing in multiplayer.

🐧The Ranchers runs natively on Linux and Steam Deck!

We are thrilled to announce that The Ranchers now runs natively on Linux, SteamOs, and the Steam Deck!
➕➕Read more here: https://wiki.ranchers.game/en/HowTo/TheRanchers-Linux-SteamDeck-Version

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/36fb52d6c9c880df52868c203347a478ed633bc3.png

While performance optimization is an ongoing process, this update is a significant step toward our goal of having The Ranchers fully optimized for its release day and certified Steam Deck ready!

Besides from all these features, we have also improved on the general experience when playing The Ranchers and fixed various Bugs and Crashes in the game: 

🌼 As part of our optimization efforts, we have reduced the game's memory usage (VRAM) by a whopping 45% through some wizardry and extensive "cleaning", resulting in a much more stable game even during heavy load/stress! 
🌼 A much faster loading time, between menu screen and when the gameplay start. (reduced by 20.4% to be precise )  
🌼 We have also balanced the summer weather by reducing the amount of rain and fog. 
🌼 We have significantly reduced the mass of birds' physics to prevent them from causing traffic mayhem when they collide with NPC cars.  
🌼 All known "ropes bugs" have been fixed!

Finally, I hereby announce, with the delivery of this update and the full legislative authority granted to me by The Ranchers Country, that the Alpha version is officially deemed complete! 🎊🥳

🥳Let's start the Beta chapter! 🥳

So, what's next?
The next update will be a Community Update!  🎉
We will be studying and implementing all the great alpha-feedback we have received from you with a big focus on quality of life and in-game onboarding!

If you haven't given your feedback on the alpha yet, or if you have anything else you want us to seriously consider, now is the time to share your thoughts with us! Feel free to post your feedback here: The Ranchers - Official Roadmap & Community feedback

💖 Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, and stay tuned for more exciting updates! 🔥

Ethan
-----------------------------------------

For more information about everything, check out our Wiki page: http://wiki.ranchers.game/

Click here to see our Roadmap for the development: http://ranchers.game/roadmap

Click here to joining our Discord to make sure that you don’t miss a thing: https://www.ranchers.game/discord

Click here to see our dev update videos for Ranching v2: 
[previewyoutube=uRmIeA0xS5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Ranchers Dev-Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Ranchers,

I hope you are all safe and doing great!

First of all, my deepest apologies for the recent silence. As you all know, the recent world situation was a bit scary for all of us and we were affected like everyone else with what's going on as we do have partners, friends, teammate in both sides and our top priority was to make sure that everyone is safe first!

Despite all this turbulence we have managed a great progress in developing the game, and I'm truly proud of all the efforts given by our team, and very grateful for all the support we have received from the community to overcome all these recent challenges!

Many thanks from the bottom of my heart for all your support, love and understanding ❤️

This DevUpdate is a special one as we do have many surprises and great news we do want to share with you!

Without further ado let's start by presenting our new batch of bachelors:

Character Reveals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/cd25b5c182d3814e0b7dae3bd9ae938f24bb3789.png

Meet Alicia, Ivan, Hazel and Bruno (left to right).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/52667be8498bc6072481529ecec455f6ab0646ee.png

Alicia is not just any bachelorette in The Ranchers world! With a sturdy character, she has a good sense of how fashion can be a self expression tool. She runs ones of the very famous clothing boutiques in The Ranchers Country city center.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/404907556f4c6ee43127a4501f1ee26b4c986794.png

Ivan is a passionate hunter. He is the person to reach out to if you need to know anything related to hunting or firearms. His dream is to open an armory shop in The Ranchers Country, find love and start a family.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/fb85118d562712412ec020d2816657d6e9df9791.png

Hazel the famous local travel and foodies influencer, will she have time for both love and a booming career?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/90b05e6ae9371808d2802ce991070a19ec94aac2.png

Bruno You need a truck, a bike or even a sport car? Bruno is your man! He is by far the most skilled car and bike expert and enthusiast in the Ranchers Country. He owns and runs (with his brothers) the most luxurious car dealer shop downtown. He is also an eligible bachelor.

New Vehicles!
We're excited to reveal four new categories of vehicles that we introduced in The Ranchers world. Each vehicle has a specific set of states like speed, handling, acceleration, passenger capacity, storages capacity and energy need/consumption...

Vehicles can be bought from one of the car dealers in the Ranchers Country to make deliveries, transport your animals, explore far away places or simply to cruise around with your friends or beloved one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/fcb36746b70f29b9f5681b18b2fa98ba692fe945.png 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/d553ba3ccd5ea4ebfdb3aa6b0798882acac4fb43.png 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/1106deefad9924fac43b6617a134267cd1640fe4.png 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/9eefd7ac9d5a583c5a1477dcc2780dc61c7f70c4.png 

Energy is key!

Depending on the type of vehicle you are using, some of them, for instance bicycles, will drain your player energy while others will need electricity or fuel!

For example, you can refuel your vehicles with thermic engines at one of many gas stations in the Ranchers world and if you do plan to go off-road for a longer period make sure to have some fuel jerricans just in case ;)

Here is an example of how refueling your Kamikazi with a fuel jerrican will work:

[previewyoutube=ijW0BNZiLF0;full][/previewyoutube]

And of course, driving conditions are also related to the weather conditions :)


Your livestock are going places!
In The Ranchers, you can transport your livestock from one place to another and with good reason: transporting them to the veterinary, the city farmer's market, livestock events & contests... Or simply feeding your animals for free by bringing them to some prairies once there is no more wild grass in your ranch :)


Some livestock can simply be transport on bicycles :D

[previewyoutube=xuVHCbSGVdc;full][/previewyoutube]

...And some will need a proper truck to transport them safely:

[previewyoutube=oJ5nbN96kK0;full][/previewyoutube]


The Systemic Engine!
The Ranchers is built on top of our in-house "Systemic Engine" layer, which is a technical term to brag a bit and say's that all props in the game are interactibles and do react to the weather conditions, players/NPCs interactions and to the classical elements (water, fire, air...).

We took huge inspiration from games like the Zelda breath of the wild and how having a "Systemic Engine" can bring a huge level of realism, leading to a unique and totally autonomous world simulation while giving our players an unseen level of freedom by experimenting with The Ranchers open world.

And to illustrate all of this, we did prepare a small set of video to showcase how all of that work by taking a simple example, as "How to cut a tree in The Ranchers?":

Method 1 - By using your Axe (or any sharp item - Yes, you can use a fork!)
[previewyoutube=un-Zj-IH7ew;full][/previewyoutube]

Method 2 - By using your car or truck
[previewyoutube=A1I9Q0Y1IyU;full][/previewyoutube]

Method 3 - By using guns
[previewyoutube=yswtqyQf3OI;full][/previewyoutube]

Method 4 - By using your imagination!
[previewyoutube=mYvUNBU9YB8;full][/previewyoutube]


One other way of using your imagination or your knowledge is to be able to answer those types of questions like: "How to create charcoal in a forest?"

Nomally charcoal is an abundant resource found in mines, so it makes total sense to get it from there. BUT there are also many clever and free ways of doing just that and the game will never tell you about them! 

It's really up to you and your knowledge to discover all those secrets ;)

Let's start spoiling one way of achieving that: 

 Burning 🔥 wood logs 🪵 will turn them to charcoal!

But be aware, that only works when it's ☀️, when it's 🌧️ ...that's another story :)

And here is how it looks like in game:
[previewyoutube=pp9bq9J7PUw;full][/previewyoutube]

You think you get it? Great! 
Here are other questions: "How to make cement?", "How to make glass?", "How to make butter?" and the list goes on... :D

The Ranchers is going places too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/36fb52d6c9c880df52868c203347a478ed633bc3.png

We are truly excited to announce that The Ranchers will be optimized day one for the Steam Deck!

What's next?
That's all folks! Hope you have enjoyed this "exceptionally long" update! As always, your feedback is more than appreciated! 

Feel free to join us on Discord to let's us know what do you think of all those announcements.

Oh yeah, The Ranchers is coming to Kickstarter 🎉🎉this July🎉🎉!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Make sure to join our Discord Server, Wishlist The Ranchers on Steam and subscribe to our Kickstarter page to don't miss the precise date and when the Kickstarter campaign will go live!

Kickstarter backers will gain exclusive access to our closed Alpha! So if you want to play The Ranchers earlier and shape it with us, make sure to secure your exclusive closed Alpha copy!

notes.title: The Ranchers Dev-Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello Ranchers,

Welcome to The Ranchers first dev-update! 

First of all I want to deeply thank you all for all the love and support we did get from this great community! Things went really fast and in an incredible way since we first announced The Ranchers trailer!

Today, We are more than 3 000 members on Discord! and The Ranchers is hiting new wishlists record everyday! Thank you again for all your support!

Without further ado lets start by presenting our first batch of bachelors:

Character Reveals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/22355512e3abbaee066251f406199bf22c58103a.png

Meet Chris, Nina, Pablo and Eva (left to right)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/465278fb1ceb16d56568ff77678f9cd3ba0a76f2.png

Chris is an eligible bachelor, he runs "The Aliens" bar, one of the best places to relax, have a drink, listen to some music and meet new people in the Ranchers Country city center.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/e8c09f9769eaec6bbd37ed7fa83881ad2f9670ad.png

Nina lives her bachelorette life with her father and 2 brothers. She spends most of her time in her pastry shop, trying out new recipes!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/7327ee4c38d370fc5b953d68aa8b4db429eaf9a0.png

Pablo came from far lands to start his Ranchers dream. Today, he is one of the most respected and wealthiest businessman in Ranchers Country. He is also eligible bachelor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/dc73655afbcfa012739ea17da338f1003e6d3df5.png

Eva is a good candidate to marry and well known fashionista in The Ranchers country. She runs one of the best (and most expensive) hairdressing salon in the city center.

HUD UI
We're excited to reveal The Ranchers HUD game UI. We did our best to keep it clean and non intrusive while it continues giving you all the required information.

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/20297d60e486808cc8cd344fd98308849feee251.png 
[click on image to enlarge]


And here is the HUD UI explained :

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/25f4a046d4f9fa1cdc1ee13e48bb884924a7998c.png 
[click on image to enlarge]

Of course the HUD UI will change depending on what item you have equipped in your hands (showing how much water available in your water can...) or what are you doing in the game. Here is an example of how it looks with you are driving your delivery vehicle:

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/3ca1d524f56c8fe76d0c9d37740c5b1efab43bec.png
[click on image to enlarge]


Camera Movements

In The Ranchers, the camera can move 360° around your character. You can also zoom-in and zoom-out at any time to have a better understanding of your environment.

[previewyoutube=5XQL5j8KydI;full][/previewyoutube]

iPear: Your in-game Smartphone
You can access all the game menus (Craft blueprints, Quests, Game Settings...) and other Apps via your in-game smartphone gracefully provided by iPear INC. Here is a quick presentation of iPear UI and all the available Apps so far:

[previewyoutube=WvOJGETNNG0;full][/previewyoutube]

Bykii: Need a ride? rent a bike!
Bykii is the official transportation company in The Ranchers world. Among other transportation services, Bykii do have a lot of bike renting stations spread in The Ranchers open world to let you move fast, anywhere (and workout your muscles mass).

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/b55320e87d96b894a91cda08fe74c8eefe85cfef.png
[click on image to enlarge]


Here is a showcase of how Bykii terminal works. The next video showcase also the in game chat feature between 2 players in co-op ;-)

[previewyoutube=7VhRLcBNOvQ;full][/previewyoutube]

What's next?
Next Dev-Update we will be talking about the systemic engine and how all items and decors in The Ranchers world are affected by the weather and your behaviour and how you can turn that in your advantage ;)


That's all folks! Hope you did enjoyed this update! As always, your feedback is appreciated! 
Feel free to join us on Discord to let's us know what do you think of all those announcements.

Thanks for reading,

Ethan

PS: Our Kickstarter backers, will gain access to The Ranchers Alpha to play The Ranchers earlier! If you didn't follow The Ranchers on Kickstarter, it's still not too late! (not for too long :P )
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397151/d42a0fdd1f20ac46f2c39b2de8158ccfa122d6b9.png
